title: 法德利差：升至2011年水平，近乎垂直的线还能走多远？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And a gauge of French government bond risk has hit the highest level in 15 years as energy prices continue to rise. Joining us now is Bloomberg Rates and FX reporter
segments.zh: 随着能源价格持续上涨，法国国债风险指标已升至15年来最高水平。彭博利率与外汇记者

segments.en: Alice Gladhill. Alice is probably worth just revisiting the forces behind it. What is pushing the pricing of risk around this asset ever higher and does there look to be
segments.zh: Alice Gladhill加入我们。Alice，或许值得回顾一下背后的力量。是什么推动该资产的风险定价不断走高，近期是否

segments.en: any release valve in the near future? So I think there's a couple of things going on. So obviously we've seen global
segments.zh: 存在任何释放压力的途径？我认为有几个因素在起作用。显然，我们看到全球

segments.en: government bonds sell off this year. In Europe in particular, bonds have been hit by the energy crisis, that's because the ECB has been forced into rate hikes and that sort of persheals across the
segments.zh: 政府债券今年遭抛售。尤其是在欧洲，债券受到能源危机冲击，因为欧洲央行被迫加息，这种压力蔓延至

segments.en: region higher. The other part of the story in France of course is that investors are concerned about the fiscal story there and the political pressures. And I think very clearly that that is
segments.zh: 整个地区，推高利率。法国的情况还有一点，市场参与者担忧其财政状况和政治压力。我认为很明显，这

segments.en: part of the reprising that we're seeing. So we had the chart previously on the screen of the spread premium or the the yield premium between France and Germany and that's reached levels
segments.zh: 是我们看到的部分重新定价。之前屏幕上的图表显示了法国和德国之间的利差溢价或收益率溢价，已达到

segments.en: that we lost in 2011 which I think just the very sharp move you can see there just underlines quite how sharp this reprising has been.
segments.zh: 2011年以来的水平，我认为你可以看到非常急剧的变动，这凸显了此次重新定价有多么剧烈。

segments.en: Yeah, it's a really incredible chart, Alice. It's basically just a vertical line up. So I'm curious when you talk to different investment strategists and portfolio managers investors, what kind of
segments.zh: 是的，这真是一张惊人的图表，Alice。基本上就是一条垂直线。所以我很好奇，当你与不同的**策略师、**组合经理和市场参与者交谈时，他们期待什么样的

segments.en: catalyst are they looking forward to maybe put a lid on this move if any?
segments.zh: 催化剂来可能抑制这一走势（如果有的话）？
